result.summary: Found 1 significant visual issue: restaurant metadata is overlapping and unreadable.

issues.description: Below “Tokumaru Ramen Bar,” the delivery-time and delivery/category metadata overlap each other, producing garbled text such as “25–35 min” colliding with “€0 delivery · Ramen.”
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row spacing and width constraints. Use a properly aligned flex or grid layout with gaps, and allow wrapping or truncation when the content does not fit.
